sentences.text_target: Tom arrives at the office early in the morning.
sentences.phonetic: tɒm əˈraɪvz ət ði ˈɒfɪs ˈɜːli ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ.
sentences.text_native: Tom arrive au bureau tôt le matin.

sentences.text_target: He walks into his office and sits in his chair.
sentences.phonetic: hi wɔːks ˈɪntuː hɪz ˈɒfɪs ənd sɪts ɪn hɪz tʃeər.
sentences.text_native: Il entre dans son bureau et s'assoit sur sa chaise.

sentences.text_target: He puts his bag on the desk.
sentences.phonetic: hi pʊts hɪz bæɡ ɒn ðə dɛsk.
sentences.text_native: Il pose son sac sur le bureau.

sentences.text_target: He turns on his computer.
sentences.phonetic: hi tɜːnz ɒn hɪz kəmˈpjuːtər.
sentences.text_native: Il allume son ordinateur.

sentences.text_target: The screen lights up quickly.
sentences.phonetic: ðə skriːn laɪts ʌp ˈkwɪkli.
sentences.text_native: L'écran s'allume rapidement.

sentences.text_target: He uses his keyboard to type his secret password.
sentences.phonetic: hi ˈjuːzɪz hɪz ˈkiːbɔːd tuː taɪp hɪz ˈsiːkrɪt ˈpɑːswɜːd.
sentences.text_native: Il utilise son clavier pour taper son mot de passe secret.

sentences.text_target: The system opens his main email account.
sentences.phonetic: ðə ˈsɪstəm ˈəʊpənz hɪz meɪn ˈiːmeɪl əˈkaʊnt.
sentences.text_native: Le système ouvre son compte de messagerie principal.

sentences.text_target: He looks at his busy inbox.
sentences.phonetic: hi lʊks ət hɪz ˈbɪzi ˈɪnˌbɒks.
sentences.text_native: Il regarde sa boîte de réception bien remplie.

sentences.text_target: There are many new messages waiting for him.
sentences.phonetic: ðeər ɑː ˈmɛni njuː ˈmɛsɪdʒɪz ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔː hɪm.
sentences.text_native: Il y a beaucoup de nouveaux messages qui l'attendent.

sentences.text_target: One message has a very important subject.
sentences.phonetic: wʌn ˈmɛsɪdʒ hæz ə ˈvɛri ɪmˈpɔːtənt ˈsʌbdʒɪkt.
sentences.text_native: Un message a un objet très important.

sentences.text_target: He clicks on the message to open it.
sentences.phonetic: hi klɪks ɒn ðə ˈmɛsɪdʒ tuː ˈəʊpən ɪt.
sentences.text_native: Il clique sur le message pour l'ouvrir.

sentences.text_target: His boss writes about a big problem.
sentences.phonetic: hɪz bɒs raɪts əˈbaʊt ə bɪɡ ˈprɒbləm.
sentences.text_native: Son patron écrit au sujet d'un gros problème.

sentences.text_target: Tom reads the text carefully on his screen.
sentences.phonetic: tɒm riːdz ðə tɛkst ˈkeəfʊli ɒn hɪz skriːn.
sentences.text_native: Tom lit le texte attentivement sur son écran.

sentences.text_target: The document with the numbers is missing.
sentences.phonetic: ðə ˈdɒkjʊmənt wɪð ðə ˈnʌmbəz ɪz ˈmɪsɪŋ.
sentences.text_native: Le document contenant les chiffres est manquant.

sentences.text_target: He needs to reply to this issue quickly.
sentences.phonetic: hi niːdz tuː rɪˈplaɪ tuː ðɪs ˈɪʃuː ˈkwɪkli.
sentences.text_native: Il doit répondre à ce problème rapidement.

sentences.text_target: He writes a polite answer with his keyboard.
sentences.phonetic: hi raɪts ə pəˈlaɪt ˈɑːnsər wɪð hɪz ˈkiːbɔːd.
sentences.text_native: Il rédige une réponse polie à l'aide de son clavier.

sentences.text_target: He attaches the correct file to the email.
sentences.phonetic: hi əˈtætʃɪz ðə kəˈrɛkt faɪl tuː ði ˈiːmeɪl.
sentences.text_native: Il joint le bon fichier à l'e-mail.

sentences.text_target: He checks everything one more time.
sentences.phonetic: hi tʃɛks ˈɛvriθɪŋ wʌn mɔː taɪm.
sentences.text_native: Il vérifie tout une dernière fois.

sentences.text_target: Then he clicks on the send button.
sentences.phonetic: ðɛn hi klɪks ɒn ðə sɛnd ˈbʌtn.
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il clique sur le bouton d'envoi.

sentences.text_target: The message goes directly to his boss.
sentences.phonetic: ðə ˈmɛsɪdʒ ɡəʊz daɪˈrɛktli tuː hɪz bɒs.
sentences.text_native: Le message est envoyé directement à son patron.

sentences.text_target: Suddenly, his office phone starts to ring.
sentences.phonetic: ˈsʌdənli, hɪz ˈɒfɪs fəʊn stɑːts tuː rɪŋ.
sentences.text_native: Soudain, le téléphone de son bureau se met à sonner.

sentences.text_target: He picks up the phone to talk.
sentences.phonetic: hi pɪks ʌp ðə fəʊn tuː tɔːk.
sentences.text_native: Il décroche le téléphone pour parler.

sentences.text_target: It is a good client calling about the project.
sentences.phonetic: ɪt ɪz ə ɡʊd ˈklaɪənt ˈkɔːlɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt.
sentences.text_native: C'est un important client qui appelle au sujet du projet.

sentences.text_target: Tom answers all his questions with a smile.
sentences.phonetic: tɒm ˈɑːnsərz ɔːl hɪz ˈkwɛstʃənz wɪð ə smaɪl.
sentences.text_native: Tom répond à toutes ses questions avec le sourire.

sentences.text_target: After the call, he finishes his morning tasks.
sentences.phonetic: ˈɑːftə ðə kɔːl, hi ˈfɪnɪʃɪz hɪz ˈmɔːnɪŋ tɑːsks.
sentences.text_native: Après l'appel, il termine ses tâches du matin.

sentences.text_target: He closes the application on his computer screen.
sentences.phonetic: hi ˈkləʊzɪz ði ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃən ɒn hɪz kəmˈpjuːtə skriːn.
sentences.text_native: Il ferme l'application sur l'écran de son ordinateur.

sentences.text_target: Tom takes a short break to drink some coffee.
sentences.phonetic: tɒm teɪks ə ʃɔːt breɪk tuː drɪŋk sʌm ˈkɒfi.
sentences.text_native: Tom fait une courte pause pour boire un café.

sentences.text_target: He returns to his desk feeling happy.
sentences.phonetic: hi rɪˈtɜːnz tuː hɪz dɛsk ˈfiːlɪŋ ˈhæpi.
sentences.text_native: Il retourne à son bureau l'esprit serein.

sentences.text_target: He completes his work for the morning.
sentences.phonetic: hi kəmˈpliːts hɪz wɜːk fɔː ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ.
sentences.text_native: Il achève son travail pour la matinée.

sentences.text_target: It is a very good day at the office.
sentences.phonetic: ɪt ɪz ə ˈvɛri ɡʊd deɪ ət ði ˈɒfɪs.
sentences.text_native: C'est une très bonne journée au bureau.
